correctness.rationale: The classical rank-shell Fourier transform F_n(rank A) follows from subspace Möbius inversion. Multiplying the invertible-set indicator by (1+(-1)^eps chi_I)/2 shifts frequencies by I, giving lambda_eps=(F(rank A)+(-1)^eps F(rank(A+I)))/2. Disjoint kernels ker A and ker(A+I) permit Gaussian subspace-pair counting and exact double inversion. Adjacent highest-rank shell magnitudes are the unique opposite-sign tie; hence C0 zero iff (u,v)=(0,1) or (1,0) and C1 zero iff u=v; their kernels disjoint. The bounded Gaussian moment convergence yields independent limiting nullity laws. Independently enumerated full Walsh spectra n=2,3 (nullities (6,8),(196,216)) and rank-predicate counts n=4 (23280,28224); those finite counts only corroborate the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Only F2 additive matrix-space convolution, n>=2; asymptotic rates are infinite theorem consequences, not inferred solely from n<=4 checks.
